description.value: Loudmouth Brewing Co is a craft brewery and restaurant established in 2018 in Abbotsford, pairing house-brewed beers with a kitchen focused on fresh-ground beef burgers, smoked brisket, and pulled pork BBQ. All burgers are made from daily-ground beef with no fillers, and smoked meats are prepared in-house using locally sourced ingredients. The brewery also offers full catering services, making it a capable stop for larger cycling groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Loudmouth Brewing is an active brewery and full-service restaurant founded in 2018, with a detailed burger, BBQ, and sandwich menu; this corroborates the OSM craft=brewery and amenity=bar tags. The website uses 'Loudmouth Brewing Co' while OSM records 'Loudmouth Brewing' — a minor name discrepancy flagged in concerns. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities, so those are null; the one confirmable amenity is a vegetarian menu item explicitly marked '(V)'.
